kapak.alt: Tilt and acceleration feel alike to the otoliths

youtube.baslik: Why does a plane accelerating in the dark feel like it is pitching up? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: For the otolith organs, tilting the head back and accelerating forward are very similar stimuli. The brain resolves this using the semicircular canals and vision; without visual cues, as in a plane accelerating in the dark, a nose-up illusion can occur.
